Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 2

Neuralware. Borgware. Wants a Neuroport Cyberdeck Port plus 2 Neuralware Option Slots, and no user may have two. Three things follow while it sits installed: Interface Rank reads 1 higher whenever INT exceeds it and the user is Jacked In, Neuroports included; TECH and INT checks about digital data or systems, decryption and reading security among them, gain 2 while Jacked In; and the day's first NET Action after Jacking In to an architecture outside a Neuroport is free.

Foundry notes:

  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Neuralware).
